The provided document does not contain information about integrating with Honcho, passing user identifiers to Honcho via `/v1/chat/completions`, or generating Honcho peers.

**Best guess:** Hermes Agent manages memory and identity primarily through its own files (`USER.md`, `MEMORY.md`, `SOUL.md`) and profile system (`hermes profile`). If you are routing through an OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint integrated with Honcho, passing a user identity typically relies on standard OpenAI API parameters (such as the `user` field in the request payload) or custom metadata/headers forwarded via middleware or plugins (`pre_llm_call` hooks), but native Honcho parameter forwarding is not documented here.
